approved: lead, 2026-10-22: min hops enforced (#283); a recursive variable-length path ignored its lower bound on main
cypher: MATCH (a:S__Line)-[:ECHOES*2..3]->(b:S__Line) RETURN a.id AS a, b.id AS b

sql.bigquery: WITH RECURSIVE _traverse_a AS (SELECT _seed.`id` AS src_id, 'S__Line' AS cur_type, _nxt.`id` AS cur_id, 1 AS hops FROM `sonnets`.`sonnets`.`line` AS _seed INNER JOIN `sonnets`.`sonnets`.`echo` AS _nxt__via ON _seed.`id` = _nxt__via.`line_id` INNER JOIN `sonnets`.`sonnets`.`line` AS _nxt ON _nxt__via.`echo_line_id` = _nxt.`id` UNION ALL SELECT t.src_id, 'S__Line' AS cur_type, _nxt.`id` AS cur_id, t.hops + 1 AS hops FROM _traverse_a AS t INNER JOIN `sonnets`.`sonnets`.`line` AS _cur ON _cur.`id` = t.cur_id AND t.cur_type = 'S__Line' INNER JOIN `sonnets`.`sonnets`.`echo` AS _nxt__via ON _cur.`id` = _nxt__via.`line_id` INNER JOIN `sonnets`.`sonnets`.`line` AS _nxt ON _nxt__via.`echo_line_id` = _nxt.`id` WHERE t.hops < 3) SELECT a.`id` AS a, b.`id` AS b FROM `sonnets`.`sonnets`.`line` AS a INNER JOIN _traverse_a AS _t ON _t.src_id = a.`id` AND _t.cur_type = 'S__Line' AND _t.hops >= 2 INNER JOIN `sonnets`.`sonnets`.`line` AS b ON b.`id` = _t.cur_id
